ranked.headline: Spatial statistics and models map gene and tissue organization across modalities
ranked.summary: Spatial omics and histology datasets now support joint statistical and deep-learning analysis of tissue organization at single-cell and Visium HD resolution.

ranked.headline: Learned omics representations integrating modalities, cells, and patient trajectories
ranked.summary: Deep latent models for single-cell, spatial, microbiome, and imaging-genomic data now emphasize standardized pipelines and cross-donor, cross-modality mapping.

ranked.headline: Domain-specific sequencing pipelines for annotation, variants, and genome editing design
ranked.summary: Long-read, single-cell, and duplex sequencing methods are being adapted to specific genomes and clinical truth sets in recent preprints.

ranked.headline: Deep learning and physics-based methods benchmarked for predicting molecular binding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark co-folding, docking and free-energy methods against each other on binding affinity and pose prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Long-read and single-cell methods infer chromosome architecture and X-state de novo
ranked.summary: Uncertainty-aware inference from long-read and single-cell data now extends chromosome-level analysis to evolutionary and single-genome questions.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned models link backbone geometry to sequence design and energetics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints condition DNA, protein, and RNA models on explicit 3D structure for design, scoring, and energy inference.

ranked.headline: Curated references and coverage models reshape microbiome taxonomic profiling
ranked.summary: Attribution of microbiome measurements depends on curated references and contamination-aware profiling models.

ranked.headline: Single-cell data map cell-type-specific regulation and disease risk
ranked.summary: Single-cell eQTL and risk-modeling methods now resolve regulatory and phenotypic effects within specific cell types rather than bulk tissue.

ranked.headline: Scrutinizing uncertainty, selection, and variability in molecular prediction models
ranked.summary: Recent work from late 2025 applies formal uncertainty, conformal, and PBPK validation methods to test how molecular predictions are trusted.

ranked.headline: Genomic identifiers and classification frameworks for bacterial pathogen taxonomy
ranked.summary: Hierarchical, threshold-based genomic identifiers now formalize bacterial taxonomy alongside read-based resistance and HGT detection tools.

ranked.headline: Pretrained and synthetic-data models reduce annotation needs in cell imaging
ranked.summary: Annotation bottlenecks in cell imaging are being addressed through synthetic data, pretrained networks, and foundation segmentation models.

ranked.headline: Simulated ground truth reveals coverage and tuning limits in sequencing analysis tools
ranked.summary: Simulated ground truth now locates where added sequencing depth and parameter tuning stop improving variant detection and mapping performance.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools formalize omics results, annotations, and benchmarking workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications describe software for reusable data structures and interfaces across omics analysis, annotation, and benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-level tools for linkage, haploblocks, crossovers and simulated genotyping
ranked.summary: Recent tools operate on haplotype units rather than single markers for association, recombination and simulation analyses.

ranked.headline: Supervised models map molecular and clinical inputs to cancer treatment outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply supervised learning across omics, EMR, and histology inputs to cancer prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking exposes method-dependent gene selection in scRNA-seq analysis pipelines
ranked.summary: Analytic choices in scRNA-seq, from gene selection to pseudobulk and clustering, shift outcomes, which motivates systematic side-by-side comparison of methods.

ranked.headline: New genetic association methods target loci, epistasis, causal graphs and methylation
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale cohorts and multi-disorder GWAS now allow statistical tests of pleiotropy, epistasis, and gene-regulatory causality across complex traits.

ranked.headline: Computational models infer RNA translation and modification from sequence and omics data
ranked.summary: Genomic language models and multi-omics mining are now being benchmarked and applied to RNA translation, vesicle cargo, and modification prediction.

ranked.headline: Quantitative scoring frameworks extend transcriptomic and regulatory feature analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply quantitative scoring to transcriptomic, spatial, and regulatory datasets across tissue, cancer, and host-pathogen contexts.

ranked.headline: Models predict single-cell transcriptional responses to genetic and drug perturbations
ranked.summary: Standardized benchmarks now test whether perturbation models generalize across 29 datasets and transfer to drug response prediction.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained ensembles reveal entropy-driven dsRNA unwinding by DDX3X
ranked.summary: Reduced-resolution ensemble modeling, paired with scattering and in vivo measurements, now resolves helicase and chromatin mechanisms.

ranked.headline: Neural surrogates and redesigned simulators for stochastic reaction network inference
ranked.summary: Neural methods are being applied to stochastic reaction networks and metabolic dynamics, with reported reliability guarantees and variance reduction.

ranked.headline: Computational tools trace atom fate and metabolite stereochemistry in reaction networks
ranked.summary: Exact assembly index computation on 300k COCONUT natural products and curated terpene synthase mechanisms enable scalable chemical space analysis.

ranked.headline: LLM agents automate genomic, transcriptomic, and single-cell interpretation tasks
ranked.summary: Natural-language LLM agents aim to make NGS, annotation, and perturbation-signature analysis accessible to non-specialists.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking interpretable ML, microbiome modeling, and differential metaproteomics…
ranked.summary: Standardized benchmarks now test interpretability, feature representation, and statistical choices for high-dimensional biological data.

ranked.headline: Compressed k-mer indexing and sketching methods for ancient DNA and metagenomic reads
ranked.summary: Recent items pair compression, sketching, and authentication metrics for ancient and metagenomic sequence workflows.

ranked.headline: Joint modeling of correlated traits and genealogy improves genetic association testing
ranked.summary: Recent methods extend association testing to multivariate traits, multi-omics data, genealogical structure, and privacy-preserving multi-site designs.

ranked.headline: Reference genome choice shapes single-cell annotation and plant genomic inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark apple reference assemblies for snRNA-seq and report a T2T Indigofera assembly, making reference choice an explicit variable.

ranked.headline: Post-calling refinement combines population, phenotype, and read evidence per variant
ranked.summary: Recent tools integrate population frequency, ACMG and ClinVar checks, and read-level heterozygosity into individual variant decisions.

ranked.headline: Protein and genome language models applied to function, site, and promoter prediction
ranked.summary: Pretrained protein and genome language models are now being fused with downstream classifiers for site, promoter, and genome prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Force field corrections and GPU constant-pH MD advance biomolecular simulation accuracy
ranked.summary: Recent 2025 papers address known force-field errors in phosphate ion binding, GPU constant-pH MD, and small-molecule parametrization for docking.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies link transposons and population size to genome architecture
ranked.summary: Long-read and hybrid assemblies now resolve structural rearrangements, transposon dynamics, and gene repertoires across invertebrate and avian lineages.

ranked.headline: Curated multi-omics resources map regulatory effects onto traits and disease heritability
ranked.summary: Expression-to-trait mapping in chicken and human tissues now spans context-specific eQTL resources and network-flux models of regulatory circuits.

ranked.headline: MD, ML, and deep learning resolve GPCR activation mechanisms and ligand binding modes
ranked.summary: Computational models now resolve how lipid ligands, sterols, and ML-identified residue networks control GPCR conformational states.

ranked.headline: Structure-first computational design of nucleases and antibodies
ranked.summary: December 2025 reports pair structure-conditioned generation with evolutionary constraints and developability criteria for nucleases and antibodies.

ranked.headline: Tools linking GWAS loci, metabolite signatures and exercise omics to candidate genes
ranked.summary: Standardized gene evidence packets, metabolic-model mapping and integrated exercise omics resources now streamline candidate gene prioritization across domains.

ranked.headline: Enhanced-sampling simulations predict GPCR activation and drug residence times
ranked.summary: Automated enhanced-sampling protocols now target absolute kinetics and activation free energies with explicit transferability and robustness goals.

ranked.headline: Computational mapping of protein and lipid localization across subcellular compartments
ranked.summary: Spatial proteomics and organelle profiling data now support open-source localization prediction tools and curated pathway reconstructions.

ranked.headline: MD-based residue analysis maps distal activation and binding energetics in proteins
ranked.summary: Microsecond MD and AI-driven residue decomposition are extending physics-based simulation to resolve distal activation and recognition mechanisms.

ranked.headline: Contact structure and behavioral feedback reshape epidemic thresholds and stability
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend SIR and SIS frameworks with infection age, reinfection, network curvature, and opinion coupling.
